title: A Gradient-Optimized TSK Fuzzy Framework for Explainable Phishing Detection
abstract: arXiv:2504.18636v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Phishing attacks represent an increasingly sophisticated and pervasive threat to individuals and organizations, causing significant financial losses, identity theft, and severe damage to institutional reputations. Existing phishing detection methods often struggle to simultaneously achieve high accuracy and explainability, either failing to detect novel attacks or operating as opaque black-box models. To address this critical gap, we propose a novel phishing URL detection system based on a first-order Takagi-Sugeno-Kang (TSK) fuzzy inference model optimized through gradient-based techniques. Our approach intelligently combines the interpretability and human-like reasoning capabilities of fuzzy logic with the precision and adaptability provided by gradient optimization methods, specifically leveraging the Adam optimizer for efficient parameter tuning. translated_title: 一种用于可解释钓鱼检测的梯度优化TSK模糊框架
translated_abstract: 钓鱼攻击对个人和组织构成了日益复杂和普遍的威胁，造成重大经济损失、身份盗窃以及机构声誉的严重损害。现有的钓鱼检测方法往往难以同时实现高准确率和可解释性，要么无法检测新型攻击，要么作为不透明的黑盒模型运行。为了解决这一关键问题，我们提出了一种新颖的钓鱼URL检测系统，该系统基于通过梯度技术优化的一阶Takagi-Sugeno-Kang（TSK）模糊推理模型。我们的方法巧妙地将模糊逻辑的可解释性和类人推理能力与梯度优化方法提供的精确性和适应性相结合，特别是利用Adam优化器进行高效的参数调整。在包含超过235,000个URL的综合数据集上进行的实验表……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于梯度优化的TSK模糊推理模型的可解释钓鱼URL检测框架，将模糊逻辑的可解释性与Adam梯度优化的精确性相结合，在超过23.5万条URL的数据集上同时实现了高检测准确率与良好的可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an explainable phishing URL detection framework based on a gradient-optimized TSK fuzzy inference model, which combines the interpretability of fuzzy logic with the precision of Adam-based gradient optimization, achieving both high accuracy and explainability on a dataset of over 235,000 URLs.
